queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Smartsheet' AND publisher = 'Smartsheet';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Smartsheet' AND publisher = 'Smartsheet' AND version_compare(version, '1.0.54') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'smartsheet.exe');
